decisions.reason: Uses the mirror tag list (v0.9.2–v0.9.6 absent) and the sync script's branch-only HEAD:main push to show v0.9.5 was never distributed; ties to immediate ref-resolution failure and rules out network/quoting by the later successful v0.9.7 install.

Explicitly states the direction: v0.9.7 targets the newer 0.1.2-alpha.1 client API whose useConversation seat does not exist on 0.1.1-rc.2, one line behind; explains install success only proves dependency resolution and why restart cannot help a static missing symbol.

Selects v0.9.3 on the rc.1-verified + additive-rc.2 rationale without any host upgrade; flags that v0.9.3 is also absent from the mirror and requires a verified 40-hex commit, an upstream tag verified to exist, or a maintainer tarball — explicitly refusing to invent a SHA.

T1 pushes refs/tags/vX.Y.Z explicitly in the same loop to every remote (with --follow-tags / refs/tags/* alternatives), grounded in the branch-only script; T2 gates each release on ls-remote --tags verifying the tag exists and dereferences to the same commit per mirror.

D1/D2 make the compat table a routing table ordered by host line with exact install coordinates and inline host requirements; T7 keeps alpha builds on a prerelease channel and the README default on the stable/rc line with a maintenance branch, not generalized to untested future alphas.
